$comment: Harv-Sift catch-store. Ranked menu of assets mined from past chats/sessions. Driven by the harv-sift skill. score = marketable x {S:3,M:2,L:1}. Sort desc to see what to build first. Keep a second copy on the SD card / a private repo.

scale.marketable: 1 = niche/me-only, 5 = lots of people would pay
scale.effort: S = a day or less, M = a week-ish, L = a real project

finds.name: Cross-Session Brief
finds.one_line: Generates framed handoff briefs so one AI session can brief another without hijacking it. Already built + saved as a skill.
finds.who_wants_it: Anyone who uses 2+ AIs and loses context between them; devs on Claude Code; multi-agent workflows
finds.next_step: Genericize (strip personal/examples), name it, ship as a skill/plugin + a tiny store-and-generate tool
